notes: v1.14.533 — LEGACY-RETIRE STAGE 1: THE ZERO-CONSUMER TOKEN. --omni-h was written on every phase-dock render and read by nothing. Its only consumer, the :has()-gated dock offset, was deleted in v1.14.282; the write outlived it by 251 versions because the .282 note called the measurement 'inert and left as-is', which reads as a decision rather than as debt. phdock_render no longer looks up #omni-bar or measures it. A repo-wide sweep of all 217 custom properties found 26 with zero var() consumers, but --omni-h is the only LEGACY one — the other 25 are :root design-system palette and scale entries, which are PHANTOM_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md property and out of bounds under Contract 15's R-E. No visible change: nothing read the token, so nothing moves. Redesign and legacy are affected identically, since the write was dead in both houses.
